sources: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Straits State Park resources via the booking site's /api/resourcelocation/resources and /api/maps)

values.note: DNR rate table: Straits Campground $41 a night with 20/30-amp, $46 with 50-amp, $56 full hook-up; the semi-modern (no electric) waterfront sites $36, and $25 at the rustic rate. Recreation Passport required for entry.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Straits rows: Straits Campground $56 / $46 / $41; Straits Semi-Modern (No Electric) $36 / rustic $25), read 2026-10-20

hookups.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/straits ('All sites in the upper campground loop have 20/30-amp electrical service, with some 50-amp sites available') + midnrreservations.com resources (92 sites list 50 amp), read 2026-10-20

values.note: The park page says 270 sites in three loops; the booking site lists 274 (Upper 145, Lower West 73, Lower East 56) besides two mini cabins and group sites. Upper-loop sites are larger and include 20 pull-throughs; lower-loop sites are generally smaller, many listed at 15-30 ft. The waterfront sites in the lower loops have no electric.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/straits (Number of sites: 270; 'some pull-throughs') + midnrreservations.com resources ('Pull Through', 'Site Length' attributes), read 2026-10-20

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/straits ('Modern toilet and shower buildings and sanitation stations are available seasonally') + DNR rate table (modern campgrounds include flush toilets, showers, a sanitation station), read 2026-10-20

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/straits ('For reservations call 800-447-2757 or reserve online'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed fees $25-$56 and season May 15-Oct 14 (recorded today). Added 50-amp electric, 274 campsites with pull-throughs in the upper loop, showers/flush toilets/sanitation stations, reservable. Water/sewer left unknown: the booking site shows them at a single site, and the $56 full hook-up rate has no matching description on the park page. Not stated: booking window, stays, fcfs, max rig length.
